card.name: Line endings in poetry verses
card.fires_on: The punctuation or space at the end of a poetic line, right after the last word of the line. It shows up in quoted poems and verse, not in drug-label text.

modes.label: Comma after a verse line
modes.description: A comma closing a line in a rhythmic, repeating poem.
modes.example: Fill the tongue with ancient legends<<, >>Only makes the fool more foolish."

modes.label: Space or period at a line break
modes.description: The gap or full stop where a line of free verse ends, before the next line.
modes.example: I fear more the solitary life revealed<< >>in Autumn's long spell.

card.plain: It marks the end of a line in a poem, where the next line begins.
